properties.name: Újerdő

constructionEvidence.name: Újerdő
constructionEvidence.note: Wooded southern farm/house belt around Újerdőtanya dűlő and the Álmas-dűlő access system. The envelope follows actual diagonal tracks, forest/farm parcel edges and scattered house groups; its irregular southern transition is inferred. Planning law independently identifies Újerdő as a wooded rural inhabited area, so no single forest polygon or coordinate-centred circle is used.
